data.name: Extraction '76
data.detailed_description:
ENTER. SURVIVE. EXTRACT.

Extraction ’76 is a tense, co-op extraction shooter set in an alternate late-1970s conflict—where a classified experiment has fractured time itself. Deep in the jungle, a secret weapons program has gone wrong. Now, fragments of different eras bleed into the battlefield. Weapons. Technology. Artifacts. All lost to time… and waiting to be taken.

TACTICAL EXTRACTION GAMEPLAY

Drop in solo or with your squad into hostile zones. Complete objectives, secure valuable loot, and manage limited ammo and resources. Face AI threats and rival players as you push toward extraction. Choose to engage, or avoid conflict and escape quietly. If you don’t make it out, you lose everything. 

We’re focused on delivering a game that feels incredible to play—tight controls, weighty combat, and satisfying moment-to-moment action. From destructible environments and dynamic encounters to deep weapon and loadout customisation, every system is built to create tension and reward smart decisions. Vehicles, co-op play, and evolving scenarios add layers of strategy, giving players the freedom to adapt their approach every run. It’s all about creating a responsive, immersive experience where every action matters and no two encounters play out the same.

GROUNDED TIME TRAVEL COMBAT

Combat is weighty and inspired by the late Cold War, with no futuristic crutches, just positioning, teamwork, and skill. Every shot matters, and every decision counts. Stay longer for better loot or extract early and survive, as high-risk zones offer rare rewards but no guarantee of escape.

Every run is a gamble, and what you bring out is everything. Explore jungle research facilities and war-torn outposts where conditions shift and encounters change, with multiple extraction points and unpredictable events ensuring no two runs are the same. Unlock weapons, gear, and perks to create loadouts that match your playstyle, balancing power against survivability—go in prepared, or adapt on the fly.

PRE-ALPHA & PUBLIC TESTING

Extraction ’76 is currently in pre-alpha. We’re actively developing core gameplay systems and refining the experience.

Public playtesting and demo is coming soon, join early, help shape the game, and be among the first to enter the fractured zone.

data.short_description: Extraction ’76 is a tactical co-op extraction shooter set in an alternate Cold War. Form a squad, infiltrate hostile zones, recover valuable assets, and fight your way to extraction in intense session-based missions built for teamwork and replayability.
data.supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Arabic, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 960 / AMD Radeon R9 380
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Requires a persistent internet connection Designed to run at 30–60 FPS on low settings
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-8700 / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1660 / AMD RX 5600 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD strongly recommended for faster load times Targeting 60 FPS+ on medium/high settings

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 11 (Big Sur)
  • Processor: Apple M1 or Intel Core i5 (2017 or newer)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated GPU (Metal supported)
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Requires Metal support Designed to run at low settings (30 FPS target)
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 12 (Monterey) or later
  • Processor: Apple M1 Pro / M2 or Intel Core i7
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple Silicon GPU or dedicated AMD GPU (Metal compatible)
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Optimized for Apple Silicon Targeting 60 FPS on medium/high settings
